The hardest part is not the doing. It is the knowing: being the one who always holds the full picture, because it lives only in your head.

KinCarer puts that picture somewhere the whole care circle can see it.

One shared schedule for tasks, visits and appointments. Check-ins so everyone knows someone arrived, without anyone having to call. When the picture is shared, the load is shared. Not just the doing, but the knowing.

WHO KINCARER IS FOR
Families caring for an aging parent.
Brothers and sisters sharing the care from different states.
Partners caring for someone with dementia or a chronic condition.
Families caring alongside paid caregivers or a home care agency.
Anyone who has become the one who holds the full picture.

SHARED SCHEDULE
Add tasks, visits, appointments and reminders so everyone in the care circle can see what needs doing, who is doing it, and what has already happened.

HANDOVER NOTES

Safety is the foremost concern for every family and having a consistent private care network that keeps every member connected with each other is necessary. WeTraq’s ‘GuardIO – Family Care’ is a trailblazing safety alert app incorporated with top-notch features to enable family members and caregivers to remotely monitor the whereabouts of their members instantly whenever they want. GuardIO security app is easy to use and you can count on it as a reliable remote caregiving service. It helps to assess the mobility behaviors of your family members including elders and those affected with conditions like dementia and may be at risk.  


GuardIO is essentially an iOS GPS navigation app that creates a secure private social network for your family. With salient features like location sharing, safety alerts, and driver reports, it successfully fosters family safety by keeping everyone protected and better connected.


WeTraq aims to give a new dimension to senior wellness technology with GuardIO senior safety alert app assisting families with clinical management. Caregivers of families can use it for effective risk-mitigation strategies making patient wandering safe while developing a culture of safety! 


The mission behind the development of GuardIO is to create a family GPS locator app that improves the mental health and quality of life of family caregivers while helping seniors’ age-in-place.  


With GuardIO – a pioneering Geofencing app for family safety, you get:


•	Private Care Circle - Communication is critical when dividing caregiving responsibilities. Coordinate care with other members of your private circle. 
•	Location Sharing & Smart Notifications - A private and secure way of sharing real-time views of each other’s whereabouts within your care circle. Allows you to configure the alerts from each individual member. 
•	Safe Zones & No-Go Areas - Provides an additional layer of security and peace of mind with the ability to add areas deemed to be ‘Safe Zones’ or ‘No-Go’ areas. Notifications and alerts are sent when members within your circle enter or exit these zones.
•	Low Battery Alert - Phone is the only means for seniors to contact the outside world and hence, keeping it charged is of utmost importance. Members of the care circle receive an alert for low battery.  
•	Individual Driver Reports –Get a detailed view of the driver behavior on the app for each member of your care circle. See things like over-speeding, phone usage while driving, and more that help to build safe driving habits. 
•	Trip History - Timeline of your family's past mobility behavior and trip history including stops you made along the way. 
•	One-Tap Directions - Navigate directly to any member of your care circle— no address needed. This ensures quick turnaround in case of mission-critical events. 
•	Trip Summary - The motion sensors on your phone capture events every time a risk-inducing situation occurs. It’s the information you need to have a conversation about safe driving at just the right time. 
•	Check-ins & Help Alerts - Let loved ones know that you’ve arrived somewhere safely with remote Check-in from your app. Members can also send help alerts with their location in case of an emergency or should they find themselves in an unsafe environment. 
With these notable features, GuardIO security app is unquestionably a powerful guardian security application for iOS that ensures everyone in your family is safe. It prioritizes transparency while ensuring safety monitoring and personal privacy making it a trustworthy GPS family locator app in recent times.  

Download GuardIO to enhance the personal safety of every member of your family no matter where they are and have peace of mind!
